scope: minimum Everyone-mode AirDrop /Discover from ESP32-S3 to a stock iPhone

request.body: 42-byte binary plist containing an empty dictionary

successfulRun.parserErrorMeaning: The initial bounded parser waited for connection close because chunked decoding had not yet been implemented.

followUp.reason: Later bounded attempts observed the receiver too late or missed its TCP acceptance window.

result.confirmed: The stock iPhone accepted espDrop's minimum /Discover request over the ESP32-S3 AWDL/TLS path and returned HTTP 200 with a chunked response.
result.notConfirmed: The returned plist fields, /Ask, user acceptance, /Upload, and file delivery are not yet proven.
result.nextFocus: Build and validate one bounded /Ask binary plist carrying a transfer ID, then require explicit acceptance before any upload is armed.
